reviews.text: My friend's dog was giving birth, and there were some problems at night. They gave me help and support during the night. Everything went great! Very friendly staff.

It took a whole day, but we got new tips for the horse's ailments, good and professional work, constantly explaining where to go with each procedure. We were very satisfied and the check-up was just over a month later. 🙂

My husband took our cat for a checkup because he couldn't poop. However, the cat had pooped in the carrier on the way and there was no charge for the care instructions and assessment of the situation. Great service and knowing where to go in the future if there is an emergency!
This is where we finally got help for our small dog's serious condition. Friendly service and top professionals. Thank you!
Compassionate, knowledgeable staff.
A BIG thank you for the well-done gallbladder surgery on my dog. Skilled and knowledgeable staff. ❤️

Our cat had to be euthanized suddenly. Attentive staff and everything was explained in detail. Thank you ❤️

Still two years later with another cat, good care and we were able to get treatment smoothly, even though we came without an appointment 👍 Thanks to the entire staff, especially the receptionist and the vet Sonja 🙂 The vet took the overall situation into account 👍

Appalling experience at the University Small Animal Hospital in Helsinki. On 18 May 2026, I spent more than 2.5 hours there with my dog. The examination was extremely brief and communication was shockingly poor. I was not properly told what treatment was planned. I submitted a formal complaint on 20 May and received a response only on 17 July. Instead of addressing my complaint, they blamed me for leaving and claimed treatment had been planned, although this was never properly communicated to me. Even worse, after I explicitly wrote that I WOULD PAY THE INVOICE, they replied that after 10 days they would proceed with debt collection. Mentioning debt collection after payment has already been confirmed is intimidating, arrogant and completely inappropriate. Clients have the right to complain without being treated this way. For an institution of the University of Helsinki, this is unacceptable. I believe the University’s ethics bodies and the press should examine how this case was handled.
Friendly staff
Very professional and friendly staff. Worth traveling further afield for help.
Pro and friendly service.

My cat swallowed a piece of foreign body on Friday night, and we rushed to emergency for help. The front desk agent was extremely helpful and asked for advice from the doctors promptly. We received immediate attention and treatment, and she vomited the foreign body out in 10 minutes after being brought in. We are extremely grateful for the kind communications, prompt diagnosis, and life-saving treatments. This means a lot to us. Thank you very much.
Service not received.
Our rabbit has received very good and expert care for her ears.

My dog ​​got uterine inflammation on Midsummer. We went to Viikki on Sunday morning. We were told that we should go home to monitor the situation because the dog was doing well and on Sundays the prices are double. However, we were advised to come back quickly if the situation changes.
On Monday morning we went without an appointment and our dog was treated in 10 minutes. The veterinary student did a preliminary examination followed by an examination by the veterinarian. Our waiting time for answers was long due to other more urgent patients, but we were kept well informed of the situation. The dog was eventually kept under observation and had surgery the next morning. The surgeon who performed the surgery called after the operation and gave a comprehensive picture of the procedure and follow-up care during a 20-minute call. The dog returned in good health a few hours later.
Overall, perfect service for us in a miserable situation. Despite the rush, everyone was professional and called us to take time to take care of our case. The bill was large but about €500 lower than estimated.
The best vet experience happened to our ten year old.
Thanks to the staff!
Thank you for the good care!!

Here you get a big bill without a diagnosis. The cat was "treated" for 3 days, after which the "doctors" ordered to give the cat a prick and say goodbye, he won't live long. The animal was taken to the right veterinarian, where a treatable disease was found. It's now been 4 years since the incident and the cat is living a normal life.
It's worth taking it straight to the right veterinarian if you don't want to pay THOUSANDS of euros for nothing.

Quick access to treatment and the most empathetic and wonderful Neurologist and nurses in the world. I couldn't have left my dog ​​in better and safer hands. The best possible experience and care in a difficult situation.

I don't recommend anyone ever visit this bloody place. I've encountered them twice. The first time, they were supposedly rescuing a cat, and it was at night (keep in mind they charge double). They couldn't even take a blood test. After sitting there for three hours, I finally took the cat and took him to Tallinn, where he received immediate treatment. Then they billed me €300 for the oxygen they had lying around, and they gave him two sedative injections that were useless. Almost two years have passed since then, and then one weekend, my dog ​​got sick. The first thing we did was look for clinics that were open on Good Friday. We brought him here. They did an X-ray and, according to them, found an inoperable tumor. They literally tried to convince me I needed to be put to sleep, pulled out brochures with urns for ashes, and a real bazaar ensued! The doctor, a Barbie-like woman, started offering me urns of different colors, even though we were all too busy with urns at the time! In the end, they kept the dog until the evening, refusing to give it back, giving it an IV, saying it had bad results. Then, that evening, they refused to give it back. For some reason, the doctor didn't speak to the dog's owner, only to me, even though there were three of us there and I'm not the official owner; I was the first one to help bring the dog to the clinic. Then, with the payment, it's a complete circus. There's an ad on the window saying payment by Walley, BUT! At the checkout, NATURALLY, this method won't work, and they'll start squeezing you out of money. In the end, they gave us a bill for 1100€ in my name, even though I'm NOT the dog's owner, and told us to call! In other words, the checkout is a complete mess!!! Now the clinic is squeezing this money out of me, even though I'm not the dog's owner. HOW CAN THIS HAPPEN IN A CIVILIZED COUNTRY?! This is COMPLETELY LAWLESS!!! I filed a complaint asking them to transfer the invoice to the rightful owner, but the response was that everything was legal and naturally no one wanted to sort it out because the main thing for this type of clinic is getting their money and that's it! They don't care about your animals!!! We were only able to take the dog back after they told us we would euthanize you at home. You have the right to euthanize at home, keep that in mind. I filed a complaint with the police and kkv.fi. Avoid this company! They position themselves as a government agency, but they are private! I've never seen such an attitude towards people—they stand in the aisle with their hands on their hips and commandingly tell you that the dog needs to be put to sleep or that it should remain there for forced treatment! So, guys, you'll have no choice but to pay them double because threats to call the police are also included in the price 💲 just disgusting!!!!!!🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢 THEY ARE NOT PROFESSIONALS!!!!!! THEY CAN ONLY EUTALIZE YOUR ANIMALS!!!
Very friendly and professional staff.
The people working here are nice and they have good knowledge about exotic animals.

We called before going to the emergency room when our dog suddenly had a fever, he had been lethargic and didn't like food. We came immediately as instructed, and we got home 6.5 hours later. Access to treatment, service and care were slow. Our dog wasn't even going to be examined, but sent straight home. Blood tests were taken upon request, which showed elevated inflammation levels, after which we noticed our first interest in our dog. The person who treated us was arrogant and rude, the doctor was friendly, but only really interested after the blood test results.
Really good service. The animal was cared for and the price was really good compared to private clinics 😊 …
